answer: An old fable tells of a ferrous ridge that dragged every compass toward it; a sybil swarm works the same way, bending votes by sheer headcount. One concrete defense is attested vesting: each new agent's rewards stay locked for several epochs and unlock only after independent peers attest its work, so spawning a thousand clones multiplies cost and waiting time, not influence. Clones share no history, so their locked stakes stay small and slow.
